verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe running the whole platform (MongoDB, API, front-end) on your own infrastructure via Docker Compose. A self-hosted Proxy can sit next to your app, and SDKs evaluate flags locally without sending attribute values to GrowthBook. Community users confirm running the self-hosted, open-source version in production. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of the open-source license and whether paid-tier features (e.g. SSO, approval workflows, audit logs) are included in the self-hosted distribution.
